description: YouTube search with cursor pagination — typed hits, ids, canonical URLs, filters (2 credits/page). Costs 2 credits. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh. Envelope includes cached + cachedAt on hits.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor. Leave empty for the first page; then pass the nextCursor value returned in the previous response.

duration.description: any | under_4 | 4_20 | over_20. Applies to long-form videos (not Shorts).

limit.description: Max items to return (default 20, max 200). Flat 2 credits per call.

region.description: ISO country code for localized results (default US).

name: youtube_search
title: YouTube Search
